# Local proof fixture assets

`reading-art.svg` and `travel-art.svg` are original artwork created for the
CE-03B rendering fixtures. They contain no text, scripts, external resources, or
embedded fonts. The botanical sprig uses engraved line work; the travel emblem
uses geometric mountains, a sun, and a winding road. Both use a 320 × 320 viewBox.
They are decorative assets, not page layouts or product templates. Corresponding
PNG files are local rasterizations used by the proof renderer.

The fonts are downloaded from the Google Fonts repository and retained locally
so proof generation does not require a network connection:

| Local file | Typeface | Source | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `reading.ttf` | Libre Baskerville | <https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/librebaskerville> | `reading-OFL.txt` |
| `travel.ttf` | Anton | <https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/anton> | `travel-OFL.txt` |

Both fonts are distributed under the SIL Open Font License; the accompanying
license files preserve their copyright and license notices.
